description: Renovate preset for CTCDocs projects. A project's renovate.json is one line: { "extends": ["github>ctcstack/ctcdocs"] }.

packageRules.description: Platform packages move together, and a green project gate is enough to take a patch or minor.
A platform major can move a project's own configuration; a human reads it.
Astro, Starlight and Wrangler decide what a deployment renders and where it lands.
Reusable workflows execute inside private CI holding deployment credentials, so their references are pinned to commits like any other third-party action.
Development tooling can move on its own once the gate is green.
